definitions.gloss: condolence; sympathy for the deceased and bereaved
definitions.explanation: Feelings of sorrow and sympathy expressed toward the bereaved upon someone's death. A formal term used in the context of funerals, memorial services, and official statements.

examples.japanese: {弔意|ちょうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弔意|ちょうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。

⟦{遺族|いぞく}→遺族：14886_izoku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{弔意|ちょうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧、ご⟦{冥福|めいふく}→冥福：16396_meifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I express deep condolences to the bereaved family and pray for the repose of the departed.

notes:
Composed of {弔|ちょう} (mourn, condole) + ⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧ (feeling, intention). A formal word typically found in official statements, news reports, and formal condolence messages. In everyday speech, people more often say ⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弔意|ちょうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express condolences
- {弔意|ちょうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show condolences
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{弔意|ちょうい}: deep condolences
- {弔意|ちょうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: with condolences

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧: condolences — the everyday, polite expression
- ⟦{哀悼|あいとう}→哀悼：15556_aitou⟧: mourning, grief — a formal synonym often used in the expression ⟦{哀悼|あいとう}→哀悼：15556_aitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧
- ⟦{弔辞|ちょうじ}→弔辞：22501_chouji⟧: funeral address — a speech given at a funeral
- ⟦{追悼|ついとう}→追悼：14312_tsuitou⟧: memorial, commemoration — honoring and remembering the dead
